snapshot.text: Sarvottam Cables Ltd is a manufacturer of power cables, wires and conductors listed on the NSE.
For the quarter ended June 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of 1,248 crore rupees and profit after tax of 82 crore rupees.
As of June 2026, promoters and the promoter group held 58.2% of the company's shares.

bull.text: The company's order book stood at 3,900 crore rupees as of June 2026, up from 3,150 crore rupees a year earlier.
Exports contributed 21% of revenue in Q1 FY27, an increase from 16% in the same quarter of the previous year.
Management expects the new Bharuch plant to begin commercial production in Q3 FY27 and contribute to results from the second half of the year.
The share of promoter holdings pledged to lenders decreased to 4.1% in June 2026, down from 11.5% in June 2025.

bear.text: A news report dated August 2026 states revenue rose to 1,428 crore rupees, while the company's official release reports 1,248 crore rupees for the same quarter.
